research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Docbot is researching AI-assisted image analysis for gastrointestinal care, as shown by systems for autonomous and continuously self-improving learning that identify targeted information in large-scale unlabeled data, and methods for aggregating features in video frames to improve tissue abnormality detection. Additionally, they develop systems for enhanced automated endoscopy workflow by integrating patient-specific information into decision processes, covering AI learning, image analysis, and workflow automation.

overview_description.description:
Docbot is an artificial intelligence technology company focusing on gastrointestinal (GI) diseases. Docbot’s products are built on the UltivisionAI software platform for real-time image analysis, automated reporting, and analytic tools to improve patient care and clinical workflows. 

Docbot's mission is to provide the most powerful AI-assisted image analysis solutions to revolutionize GI care.

about_short_description.short_description: Docbot is an AI technology company that offers AI-assisted image analysis solutions to revolutionize gastrointestinal care.

product.name: Certai
product.description: A cloud-based software application that offers an automated quantitative assessment of Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) using endoscopic video.

product.name: Amicai
product.description: A real-time automated polyp detection and characterization software application that differentiates hyperplastic polyps, sessile serrated adenomas/polyps, and traditional serrated adenomas.

product.name: Veritai
product.description: A real-time detection and differentiation software for precancerous tissue in the esophagus, specifically for non-dysplastic and dysplastic Barrett’s Esophagus.

product.name: Curai
product.description: A cloud-based software application that provides an automated endoscopic video quality and scoreability assessment for IBD and colon cancer evaluation.
